name: AviationStack
tagline: Real-time and historical flight data API for global aviation
description: AviationStack provides REST API access to real-time flight status, airline and airport data, historical flight information, and flight schedules worldwide. Developers use it for flight tracking dashboards, travel apps, and aviation analytics with a free tier and paid plans based on monthly request volume.

auth.details: API access key passed as the access_key query parameter on every request; obtained via self-serve signup at aviationstack.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month; personal-use license; real-time flights; HTTPS included; advanced features such as historical flights and routes require a paid plan
pricing.paid_plans: Basic from ~$49.99/mo (10,000 req), Professional, Business, and Enterprise with higher volumes and HTTPS

rate_limits: Monthly quota of 100 requests on the Free plan; no separate per-second limit is prominently published; HTTPS is included
use_cases: get real-time status of a flight by flight number or route
list flights departing from or arriving at an airport
look up airport or airline details by IATA/ICAO code
retrieve historical flight data for a given date
build a flight schedule board for an airport
